about_the_game:
Game Introduction

In a quiet corner of the world,

far away from the noise of the city,

a brother and his younger sister live a peaceful, slow-paced life.

Bound to the countryside by her fragile health,

the sister finds comfort in the unwavering companionship of her brother,

who weaves gentle seasons with his daily care.

Gathering dewdrops at dawn, counting clouds in the afternoon;

walking home hand in hand at dusk, sharing secret whispers under the starry sky.

Even a simple stroll down a narrow path,

or a warm cup of milk shared between them,

becomes a sparkling moment because of their bond.

This is a story—

about companionship and growth, about guardianship and dreams.

Within the slow-turning wheel of rural seasons,

witness how a silent yet steadfast love quietly blossoms.

Gameplay Overview

Genre: Visual Novel / Countryside Life Experience

  • Core Gameplay:

    • Play from the brother’s perspective and experience daily life with his sister.

    • Trigger interactive events based on different times of the day (morning/afternoon/evening/night).

    • Engage in conversations, provide care, and gradually build a bond with your sister.

    • Choose different ways to accompany her, influencing her emotions and health.

    • Unlock special daily events and side stories through your choices.

    System Features:

    • A dynamic seasonal system depicting the changing landscapes of the countryside.

    • A variety of daily activities (e.g., gathering herbs, helping her with walking exercises).

    • Sister’s status management system: health, mood, and trust parameters.

    • Branching storylines leading to multiple endings based on the bond you build.

    Highlights:

    • Delicate art style portraying soft and beautiful rural sceneries.

    • Heartwarming, gentle storytelling centered on healing and emotional growth.

    • Relaxing original soundtrack creating an immersive countryside atmosphere.

    • A soothing experience with no intense conflicts or dark themes, ideal for players who enjoy slow-paced, slice-of-life narratives.

short_description: 这是一部有关痴情哥哥与病弱妹妹之间，陪伴与成长、守护与梦想的小小物语。 你将得以操控哥哥与妹妹对话，陪伴她，照顾她，平衡妹妹的健康值，幸福度与心情。触发解锁各种事件与场景，回收与妹妹渡过的，幸福生活的小小碎片。
